verdict.rationale: LangSmith's API host serves an interactive Swagger UI and ReDoc backed by a published OpenAPI 3.1 spec, and the hosted REST reference on docs.langchain.com renders a runnable "Try it" playground for each endpoint, so the story is delivered directly. The probe 404s were at generic docs-site paths, while the spec is documented at a different docs path and on the API host, so they do not contradict it. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration that the Try-it playground and Swagger UI work as described.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can explore an interactive API reference with runnable examples

citations.quote: The API host itself serves an interactive Swagger UI (page title "LangSmith - Swagger UI", loading /openapi.json), with ReDoc live at /redoc.
The hosted REST reference on docs.langchain.com additionally renders a runnable "Try it" playground per endpoint (e.g. GET /api/v1/info/health).
The production API host serves its full machine-readable spec at the well-known path: an OpenAPI 3.1 document with info title "LangSmith"
